nop passed: tests pass on the unsolved environment

behavior_in_tests: The tests check schema/order, one archive effect, repeatability, and database immutability, but do not test malformed or split fragments, duplicate precedence, units, calibration, filtering, missing controls, empty cohorts, or null statistics required by the instruction.
hardcoded_solution: solution/solve.sh only runs compileall and makes no repair or computation, so it does not demonstrate deriving the requested implementation.

valid_failure_modes: Verifier execution depends on apt and downloading the uv installer and packages from the network, creating failures unrelated to the task solution; the narrow fixture also leaves most required behavior unverified.

pinned_dependencies: The image uses the mutable python:3.13-slim-bookworm tag rather than a patch-level digest or version, and the verifier separately relies on a floating Python 3.13 interpreter selection.

verify_time_inputs: All substantive assertions run against the one supplied /workspace/data/assay_catalog.sqlite catalog; no additional or freshly generated malformed, duplicate, mixed-unit, boundary, or empty-cohort inputs are tested.
oracle_investigates: The oracle script does not inspect the instruction, source, catalog, or runtime behavior and only compiles the existing package.
